project.charter.description: Returns the bound Project's current approved Charter as rendered Markdown plus its charter/revision identifiers and content/render digests. The Charter is Project data, not resident context: read it whenever its details matter to a decision. The response is scope-bound and never accepts a Project selector.

skill.section.description: Returns one server-owned Project operating-doctrine section by name. Read the matching section before the first work of that kind in a conversation and re-read it when unsure: research, documents, scope_change, tasks, milestones, release.
